findings.message: Unsupported: No record for an attack tax: CantAttack's Unless is an ObjectFilter describing a permanent, so it cannot say that the attacking creature's controller must pay {2} for each creature they control that's attacking me. There is no cost-to-attack continuous effect in the vocabulary (CostModifier is spells, AbilityCostModifier is abilities, OptionalAdditionalCost rides on spells), and no amount for "each creature they control that's attacking you" in a payment position.
